title: regression-test-runner input
description: Required dispatch-context keys for the regression-test-runner role, per agents/regression-test-runner.md Inputs section. The runner owns the regression-test-playbook.md sandbox lifecycle (Setup/Teardown) itself, running once per sprint. Unlike integ-test-runner, this role takes no featureIds (it does not close features) and no deployedSha (Part 2 runs its own fresh install against branch HEAD, not a specific cycle's deploy). Consumed by callers for pre-dispatch validation only -- never appended to the prompt or shown to the LLM.

repoRoot.description: Repo root path where regression-test-playbook.md lives.
